name: NG exhaustion chain Phase-2 execute-reset-reenter research contract

current_trusted_reentry_set.POX_OPP: priority executable candidate; not frozen from the forensic/reappearance pass alone

supporting_fixed_checkpoint_proxy.purpose: Test whether the general idea of banking an already-positive P-O-X trade suppresses the historical mechanism before exact successor-recognition timing is reproduced from raw/live data.
supporting_fixed_checkpoint_proxy.rule_plus10: If oriented return is positive at endpoint+10, bank it; otherwise preserve the original endpoint+60 exit.
supporting_fixed_checkpoint_proxy.rule_plus30: If oriented return is positive at endpoint+30, bank it; otherwise preserve the original endpoint+60 exit.
supporting_fixed_checkpoint_proxy.interpretation: Banking a positive parent at a simple causal checkpoint does not erase the broad P-O-X edge in any pre-held block. These fixed-time rules do not solve the held adverse branch and are not promoted; they only support keeping entry validity separate from later uncertainty management.

exact_uncertainty_checkpoint.reason: The canonical event table supports exact endpoint-based returns but does not by itself reproduce the earliest live recognition price of a newly detected successor exhaustion. The frozen detector/live-clock boundary must be respected; no synthetic early checkpoint will be promoted.
exact_uncertainty_checkpoint.required_next_test: Reproduce the earliest causally valid successor-exhaustion recognition time using the frozen detector/live stream semantics, mark the parent position to market at that exact decision time, then OOT-test bank-positive/reset versus preserving the original exit.
